more_info.uses: EU permissions include fruit wine and made wine. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.daily_intake: 240 mg tartaric acid/kg body weight/day, included in the combined L-tartaric acid and tartrate group (EFSA, 2020).
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern at reported food-use levels.
The assessment assumes conversion to L-tartaric acid before systemic exposure.
more_info.overview: Metatartaric acid is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
